title: US State ID Renewal
description: Complete the standard US state identification-card renewal process, from identifying the correct DMV authority through temporary paper ID issuance and mailing.

steps.title: 1. Identify State Authority
steps.description: Locate the specific state's DMV or licensing authority website because rules, fees, and portals vary by jurisdiction.

steps.title: 2. Determine Renewal Method
steps.description: Check whether the applicant is eligible for online renewal or must renew in person because lawful presence often must be re-verified.

steps.title: 3. Gather Identity And Status Documentation
steps.description: Collect the current state ID, Social Security evidence, passport, visa, I-94, and active I-20 or DS-2019 as applicable.

steps.title: 4. Gather Proof Of Residency
steps.description: Secure two physical documents proving the current in-state residential address.

steps.title: 5. Complete Application Form
steps.description: Pre-fill the state-specific renewal application online or prepare the paper form.

steps.title: 6. Schedule DMV Appointment
steps.description: Book an in-person DMV appointment to avoid unpredictable walk-in queues.

steps.title: 7. Complete In-Person Processing
steps.description: Present original documents, complete any screening, and take a new ID photo.

steps.title: 8. Process Payment
steps.description: Pay the state-mandated ID renewal fee using an accepted payment method.

steps.title: 9. Obtain Temporary Documentation
steps.description: Receive the temporary paper ID and confirm the mailing address for the final REAL ID-compliant card.
